[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd fix

# The linter and the race detector accept a child that waits for a
# sub-deadline while ignoring its group context: a receive from any
# Done channel is exempt from correctness::unbounded_channel_op, no
# memory is raced, and the group joins in the end.
logos lint ./stalled
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./stalled
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# The monitor names the statement where the child waits and the fix hint.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 ./stalled
stdout '^ok '
stderr '^.*stalled[/\\]main\.lgo:17: \[conc::group_child_stalled\] a group child did not return within 200ms after its group was cancelled'
stderr 'chan receive'
stderr '^\tfix: '

# --ai-patch prints the patch brief without changing files, so the rerun
# below still reports the stall: the clean rerun later is due to the
# rewrite, not to a benign fixture.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --ai-patch ./stalled
stdout '^ok '
stdout '"line":17'
stderr '\[conc::group_child_stalled\]'
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 ./stalled
stderr '\[conc::group_child_stalled\]'

# --fix rewrites the plain receive into a select on the group context.
! logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 --fix ./stalled
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::group_child_stalled\]'
stderr 'logos conc: fixed .*stalled[/\\]main\.lgo:17'

# The rerun joins at cancellation and prints no finding.
logos conc test -stall=200ms -count=1 ./stalled
stdout '^ok '
! stderr .

# A receive on a channel the linter can see is still denied at lint
# time, so the monitor is not needed there.
! logos lint ./denied
stderr '^denied[/\\]main\.lgo:16:2: \[correctness::unbounded_channel_op\] receive from ch may block forever'

-- fix/go.mod --
module example.com/concfix

go 1.27
-- fix/stalled/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	inner, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	<-inner.Done()
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- fix/stalled/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
-- fix/denied/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	ch := time.After(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	<-ch
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
